task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A black-and-white time-lapse captures a person creating a large, intricate mural on an interior wall. The mural features swirling, organic line patterns and a large, eye-like form. The artist, wearing dark clothing, is seen on a tall A-frame ladder, painting the upper sections of the wall, and later moving around the floor. The room has a high ceiling with track lighting, a dark floor, and two large, multi-paned windows that let in bright light. A small table sits in front of the wall, and another table with supplies is visible on the right. The camera remains static, showing the gradual progression of the artwork from a partially completed state to a more finished piece.
